title: feat: Hide ViewSwitcher by default for cleaner list page UI
body:
## Problem
List page toolbar was cluttered with runtime view type switcher (6 buttons: Grid/Kanban/Gallery/Calendar/Timeline/Gantt). View type should be determined at creation in ViewDesigner, not toggled during use.

## Changes

### Component Updates
- **ListView**: Added `showViewSwitcher` prop (default: `false`), conditionally renders ViewSwitcher
- **ObjectView**: Changed logic from opt-out (`!== false`) to opt-in (`=== true`)
- **ObjectViewSchema**: Updated JSDoc to reflect new default behavior

### Design Pattern
View type selection moved to configuration-time (ViewDesigner) rather than runtime (list page). Follows Airtable's model where views have fixed, predictable types.

### Backward Compatibility
ViewSwitcher can be re-enabled when needed:

```tsx
<ListView 
  schema={{ type: 'list-view', objectName: 'contacts' }}
  showViewSwitcher={true}
/>
```

### Tests
Updated 4 tests in `ListView.test.tsx` and `ListViewPersistence.test.tsx` to explicitly pass `showViewSwitcher={true}` when testing ViewSwitcher functionality.
